# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation and engine refinements**

## Highlights

The next 4.154 release refreshes the renderer and improves the documentation delivered with SkiaSharp packages. API reference content now travels with the managed packages and is maintained alongside the source declarations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Upstream m154 fixes incorporated** — Includes the latest Chrome m154 renderer corrections in the bundled Skia engine. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **Package XML documentation improved** — Reference documentation is authored with the managed API and shipped alongside the assemblies for IDE consumers. ([#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053), [#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
